messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: [GPU_POOL_EVICTION_RATE] euw1-hosted-pool above threshold (5m avg = 3.2%). Details: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/12345
Maya: seeing a spike in pod evictions in euw1 during the 03:05 window. admission drops + eviction_count both jump. anyone oncall?
Ben: @Maya i'm on it. quick look shows node pressure and a cluster of low-priority batch jobs starting at the same time. pulling kubelet + scheduler logs.
Li: can we add eviction rate to the capacity dashboard? right now we only surface queueing/admission/headroom. correlating evictions will help root cause.
Corey: +1. PromQL to start with: ```sum(rate(evicted_pods_total{pool="hosted-euw1"}[5m])) by (reason)``` also show `admission_dropped_total` beside it.
Ben: digging in: majority of evictions are reason=OOM and reason=NodePressure. interestingly the spike lines up with our scheduled prewarm jobs — looks like prewarm workers are memory hungry.
Maya: is the prewarm still required for slot warmup? can we switch to on-demand warmup + async prefetch to avoid memory thrash?
Li: we can experiment. also consider lowering admission-controller burst threshold in euw1 (current 0.8 -> try 0.7) to reduce throttle storms, but tails will see higher latency.
Ben: i'll prepare a short canary for the admission change and add a temporary alert. also will create a grafana panel (euw1 eviction + admission) so we have side-by-side.
Corey: long-term, we should tag these batch/prewarm jobs and route them to a separate lower-priority GPU pool. tradeoff: increases reserved cost but prevents thrash on hosted SLO pool.
Maya: plan: 1) narrow prewarm memory and replicas 2) add eviction panel to capacity dashboard 3) canary admission threshold tweak 4) schedule pool rebalancing overnight. Ben can you do the canary?
Ben: yes. i'll patch admission config to 0.72 for euw1 at 10:30 UTC as a 30m canary and monitor. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/987
ops-bot: Deploy bot: admission-controller config update applied to euw1 (canary) by ben — details: https://deploys.redwood/5678
Li: added `evicted_pods_total` to the capacity dashboard and a stacked breakdown by reason. panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/euw1-capacity?panelId=5 — please validate visuals/labels.
Maya: monitoring now. if eviction rate > 2% for the next 15m we run auto-evac plan.
Ben: update: evictions down to ~0.8% after the admission tweak and prewarm replica reduction. i'll keep watching for 1h and roll back if anything odd. :thumbsup:
Corey: can we also add a short-runbook note about this pattern (prewarm -> node pressure -> evictions) in the dashboard so oncall knows immediate mitigations?
Maya: yes add a runbook section. thanks everyone for fast triage.
